## Install

1. Download `HydraSync-$VERSION$.pext` from the assets below.
2. Double-click it in Playnite and confirm the update (Playnite asks to restart), or
   extract it to `%APPDATA%\Playnite\Extensions\A76358E9-BFA2-4189-B6F3-2307EA4E217B\`.
3. Restart Playnite.

Settings live under **Add-ons → Extensions settings → Generic → Hydra Sync**.
Full changelog: https://github.com/cometmcisaac/hydra-playnite-sync/compare/v$PREV$...v$VERSION$
